title: judge validation record
description: One judge's reply to one article of a source of human ratings: data/judge-validation/<scorer>/<source>/<judge>/<record>.json, written by harness/tools/validate_judge_goyal.py and validate_judge_zhang.py. A source rates a set of summaries of an article; the judge is asked to rate them as it is for the scorer. V12 checks that the reply is bare JSON or withheld.

oneOf.title: a source that rates three summaries per article (Goyal et al. 2022): the scores are the judge's mean per summary
a source that rates a block of summaries per article (Zhang et al. 2024): the dims are the judge's ratings per dimension

block.description: Which block of the article's summaries.

order.description: The summaries' systems in the order the judge saw them.

output.description: The judge's reply; null when it is withheld.

dims.description: Each dimension's rating per summary; null when the reply did not parse.

cost_known.description: False: the cost is counted from the scorer's price table, the provider gave none.

judge_fp.description: The judge's fingerprint (judge_score.judge_fingerprint) when the reply was made.

provenance_backfilled.description: judge_fp and prompt_sha were stamped on a record that predates them (the report's provenance_note says how).
